label: Нога
description: A usage card for нога walking the full case ladder with everyday collocations.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 1. 'Нога' is the subject in its dictionary form. 2. 'Болит' is a state verb agreeing in the singular. 3. The body part performs the action of the clause.

missions.phrase: После долгого бега левая нога устала.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Adjective agreement. 1. 'Нога' stays nominative as subject. 2. 'Левая' agrees in feminine singular nominative. 3. 'Устала' matches the feminine subject with its -а ending.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 1. 'Ногу' is the direct object of the action. 2. The nominative 'нога' shifts to 'ногу' in the accusative. 3. 'Сломал' is a high-value past-tense verb.
Strategic focus: Accusative with adjective. 1. 'Ногу' is the accusative object being lifted. 2. 'Правую' agrees in feminine singular accusative. 3. 'Поднял' is a concrete physical verb.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 1. 'Ноги' is genitive after the negation 'нет'. 2. The construction 'у ... нет' demands the genitive. 3. The clause states that something is missing.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 1. 'Ноги' is genitive marking belonging. 2. 'Форму' is the head noun the genitive modifies. 3. The pair reads as 'the shape of the leg'.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 1. 'Ноге' is the dative target receiving aid. 2. 'Больной' agrees in feminine singular dative. 3. 'Помог' is a verb governing the dative.
Strategic focus: Dative experiencer. 1. 'Ноге' is dative, the part feeling the state. 2. 'Тепло' is an impersonal predicate. 3. The clause says the leg is warm without a grammatical subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental means. 1. 'Ногой' is instrumental, the tool of the action. 2. 'Топнул' pairs naturally with the instrumental. 3. The leg is the means by which the stamp is made.
Strategic focus: Instrumental instrument. 1. 'Ногой' is instrumental, showing how the push is done. 2. 'Дверь' is the accusative object pushed. 3. The sentence packs object and instrument together.

missions.phrase: У спортсмена была рана на ноге.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 1. 'Ноге' is prepositional after 'на' for a static place. 2. 'Рана' is the thing located on the leg. 3. The phrase fixes a wound to a spot.

missions.phrase: Йог долго стоял на одной ноге.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional scene. 1. 'Ноге' is prepositional after 'на'. 2. 'Одной' agrees in feminine singular prepositional. 3. 'Стоял' sets a balanced standing pose.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative. 1. 'Ноги' is the plural nominative form. 2. 'Длинные' agrees in plural nominative. 3. The pair describes both legs as a visible trait.

missions.phrase: После болезни он встал на ноги.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural accusative idiom. 1. 'Ноги' is plural accusative after 'на'. 2. 'Встал на ноги' means to get on one's feet. 3. The idiom reads both literally and figuratively.
Strategic focus: Plural instrumental scene. 1. 'Ногами' is plural instrumental after 'под'. 2. 'Трава' is the thing under the feet. 3. The preposition 'под' sets a spatial picture.
Strategic focus: Plural prepositional idiom. 1. 'Ногах' is plural prepositional after 'на'. 2. 'На ногах' means being on one's feet. 3. 'Целый день' stresses the duration.

missions.phrase: Атлет уверенно бежал на сильных ногах.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural prepositional with adjective. 1. 'Ногах' is plural prepositional after 'на'. 2. 'Сильных' agrees in plural prepositional. 3. 'Бежал' adds motion to the strong-legged image.

missions.phrase: Магазин продаёт обувь для длинных ног.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural genitive. 1. 'Ног' is the bare plural genitive after 'для'. 2. 'Длинных' agrees in plural genitive. 3. 'Обувь' is the head noun the phrase serves.
